summary: Iteration-4 testing of simplified flow (billing removed). Backend: 54/54 tests pass (39 backend_test.py + 15 test_admin_settings.py) — all migration, removed endpoints, new PUT /api/visits/{vid}/status, stats key changes, and timeline/visit no-billing assertions PASS. Frontend: initial build was broken by TWO leftover-code typos from the main agent (App.js duplicate imports, AdminPage.jsx garbage code after function close) — I fixed both so the app could be tested. After fix: dashboard now shows Completed/In progress (no Billed/Pending), sidebar has no Billing entry, /visits filter chips show only All/in progress/completed, visit detail tab list is Overview/Doctor(Clinical)/Therapist/Treatments/Photos/Mapping (no Billing tab). HOWEVER, two functional/UX gaps remain in the frontend code that the main agent must fix.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Mark as completed' / 'Reopen visit' button JSX is COMPLETELY MISSING from the render output. The component computes `isCompleted`, `canClose`, and defines `changeStatus(next)` (lines 28, 42-51, 57-58), but no <button> element is rendered anywhere. FO sees only the 'Print / PDF' button — no way to mark a visit as completed via the UI. This is the core feature of iter-4 and it is non-functional in the UI.

Admin Settings tab label still reads 'Treatment / Billing' — request explicitly requires it be renamed to 'Treatments'. TABS array: `{ key: 'treatment', label: 'Treatment / Billing', icon: Pill }` should be `label: 'Treatments'`.

Dead-code reference to legacy statuses in chip className: `visit.status === 'submitted' ? 'warning' : visit.status === 'billed' ? 'success' : 'info'`. Since no visit can ever be 'submitted' or 'billed' after migration, this always falls to 'info'. Harmless but should be simplified to in_progress/completed (e.g. info for in_progress, success for completed).

integration_issues.issue: End-to-end flow blocked because Mark-as-completed button is missing from UI; backend PUT /api/visits/{vid}/status works correctly (verified by 7 pytest tests including super_admin/fo allowed, doctor/therapist/manager forbidden, invalid status 400, reopen flow).

action_items: ADD the Mark-as-completed / Reopen button JSX to VisitDetailPage.jsx. Suggestion: render alongside the Print/PDF link (line 78-80) gated by `canClose && (!isCompleted ? <button data-testid='mark-completed-button' onClick={()=>changeStatus('completed')}>Mark as completed</button> : <button data-testid='reopen-visit-button' onClick={()=>changeStatus('in_progress')}>Reopen visit</button>)`. Include a confirm dialog before changeStatus call.
Rename AdminPage.jsx TABS treatment label from 'Treatment / Billing' to 'Treatments' (line 12).
Simplify chip className in VisitDetailPage.jsx line 75 — drop submitted/billed branches.
Re-test the Mark-as-completed flow end-to-end after fix (FO/admin should see button; doctor/therapist/manager should NOT).
critical_code_review_comments: Main agent left build-breaking typos in TWO files: (a) App.js had duplicate `import VisitsPage` and `import AuditPage` lines plus leftover `import BillingPage from '@/pages/BillingPage'` for a deleted file; (b) AdminPage.jsx had 6 lines of orphan code (lines 490-495 'ue)} placeholder={placeholder}...') after the closing `}` of a function. These would have been caught by running `yarn build` or any lint step before handoff — recommend running ESLint/build-check as part of E1's pre-handoff routine.
VisitDetailPage.jsx: changeStatus + canClose + isCompleted are dead code unless the button JSX is added — this looks like an incomplete edit that was committed without manual UI verification.
Carry-over from iter-3 still applies: AdminPage.jsx remains large, CORS allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=True still invalid, DELETE user doesn't cascade visit references.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of UI gap: incomplete edit in VisitDetailPage.jsx — main agent added the state hooks (statusBusy, changeStatus, isCompleted, canClose) and updated auth.js (close_visit:['fo']) but forgot to render the actual button JSX in the component's return.
